visual_review.scope: Six first examples for each of atx_power, m.2-ssd, m.2-ssd-slot, ram-slot and pcie-slot; not exhaustive.
findings: Inspected m.2-ssd-slot boxes enclose the heatsink covering the slot, not the visible connector.
Sampled images repeatedly show the same board; filename groups do not represent unique motherboards.
PCIe samples mark only the main long slot; other visible slots are not exhaustively labeled.
visual_review.decision: Do not train the nine-class connector detector on these labels as-is.
